assumptions: ~5k records per store is the design envelope (user-confirmed)
Dashboard API consumers are only the bundled frontend and tests, so additive endpoint changes are safe
context: Brainstorming session: dashboard scale redesign for projects with 1000s of decisions/entries. Explored code + live UI, confirmed structural scale problems, proposed 3 approaches; awaiting user pick (B recommended).
rationale: no frontend idiom survives shipping 5k full records per poll tick.
summary: Chose to require a server-side query layer (pagination, scope/type/time filters, aggregation endpoints) as the foundation of any dashboard scale redesign over pure client-side fixes
